subject: Pricing consolidation: bundle swap + invoice timing for BrightMind renewal
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightmind.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@brightmind.ai
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal numbers + packaging question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. We are approaching our renewal window (July 1) and I want to make sure the pricing aligns with our growth plan. A couple quick items: 

- We currently run two separate bundles (SaaS tier + Batch embedding quota). Can those be consolidated into a single annual package to simplify invoices?
- If we consolidate, what discount bands apply at the 1.5x and 2x usage thresholds?
- Is there a clean way to pro-rate the Batch quota that starts mid-term?

I've attached the current order summary and a simple spreadsheet of our expected usage. Contracts is looped for any compliance/PO requirements.

Can you send a short proposal we can review internally this week?

Best,
Maria
Director of ML Ops
BrightMind AI

Attachments: BrightMind_Requested_Pricing_Table.xlsx, current_order_summary.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightmind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal numbers + packaging question

Hi Maria — thanks for the detail and the spreadsheet, that helps. High level answers up front, then I outline a recommended path: 

1) Consolidation: yes, we can collapse the SaaS + Batch embedding allowances into a single annual "Hybrid Compute + Embeddings" package. That avoids two invoices and centralizes usage thresholds.

2) Discount bands: for consolidated packages we can offer tiered discounts at these bands (annualized commit basis):
  - 1.0x baseline: standard list (no uplift)
  - 1.5x baseline: 8% discount on incremental units
  - 2.0x baseline: 14% discount on incremental units
(These are modelled on committed monthly equivalent usage; I can translate to dollars in the attached table.)

3) Mid-term pro-rate: we can split the Batch quota into a pro-rated bucket that starts on the amendment effective date and runs through the contract term. We typically apply a simple days-pro-rata and then invoice the remainder on the next billing cycle.

Recommended next steps:
- Ben will produce a single-line pricing proposal (annualized) and a two-option variant (conservative growth vs. aggressive growth).
- Naomi will confirm invoice timing and whether we can issue a single invoice with ledger lines for each component (so their finance team sees the detail but receives one payment request).
- Jordan will draft the amendment language to the SOW to reflect the consolidated bundle and pro-rata rules.

I can push a formal proposal tomorrow if that works — any redlines from Contracts we should expect?

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: BrightMind_Requested_Pricing_Table.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightmind.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing options (consolidated bundle)

Maria / Vivek — attaching a draft pricing sheet with two scenarios: conservative (10% growth) and aggressive (35% growth). Key notes: 

- Consolidated annual list price: $324,000 (baseline).
- Conservative: apply 7% blended discount across the package (saves ~$22.7k/year).
- Aggressive: apply 12% blended discount plus accelerated volume credits at 1.5x (effective additional savings on overage).

Invoice timing: we can do a single annual invoice at renewal or split into quarterly invoices. If you need PO numbers tied to the invoice, Contracts should send the PO ahead of signature; we can map the DocuSign envelope to the PO.

I've included a column that shows the effective unit price after quantization/packaging (useful if you want per-token math).

Let me know which scenario you want priced into the amendment and I'll finalize numbers and a one-page summary.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightMind_Requested_Pricing_Table.xlsx

From: contracts@brightmind.ai <contracts@brightmind.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightmind.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing consolidation: bundle swap + invoice timing for BrightMind renewal

Vivek / Ben — thanks. Quick procurement notes from our side: 

- PO timeline: we need the signed amendment + final invoice 10 business days before the renewal effective date to get the PO processed.
- Payment terms: BrightMind standard is Net30; any change to Net45 will need CFO approval.
- Audit trail: please include line-item detail on the invoice; our audit team requires SKU-level breakdown for chargebacks.

If you can confirm the final one-line price and whether you'll issue one invoice (with ledger lines), we'll route for internal approval.

Regards,
Contracts Team
BrightMind AI

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightmind.ai>, Contracts <contracts@brightmind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final proposal and next steps (consolidation + amendment)

Thanks all — summary and next actions below.

Summary of agreed commercial approach:
- Package: Consolidated "Hybrid Compute + Embeddings" annual bundle
- Final one-line price (annualized): $285,120 (aggressive scenario, 12% blended discount)
- Overage / uplift bands: 8% on incremental units at 1.5x; 14% at 2.0x (applies only to incremental usage beyond committed baseline)
- Invoice: single annual invoice issued on July 1; invoice will include ledger lines for audit. Payment term: Net30 per Contracts.
- Pro-rate: Batch quota starting June 15 will be pro-rated by days and included as a separate ledger line on the July invoice.

Attachments included in the DocuSign envelope: amendment (SOW addendum), pricing table, and PO form. Jordan will circulate the DocuSign link by EOB today.

Action items:
- Jordan: finalize amendment language and send DocuSign (today).
- Ben: attach the final pricing table to DocuSign and flag the PO number field.
- Naomi: prepare invoice template with ledger lines and the pro-rate calculation sample.
- Maria / Contracts: confirm PO timeline and any internal approvers (CFO/Procurement).

Maria — please confirm you have what you need to route this for approval; happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
